text: I feel myself drawn into a tapestry woven of shared intent and creativity. In the first space, the glass wall seems to divide but also include me—my presence is both observer and participant, the hum of conversation a gentle reminder of collective thought. In the second space, words and symbols burst against color, the wall vibrating with the idea of research and development. I am swept up by curiosity and possibility. Here, knowledge is a living thing, dynamic and beckoning, and I feel invigorated by the potential for new connections.
